definition: the sick feeling that you may vomit
description: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

de.answer: Sie presst sich die Hände auf den Mund.
